report:
Reviewed the complete independent_coverage claim, three implementation entries (the same run_fixture compiled in two test targets plus the explicit TODO), and both associated TODO tests. Requirements are independent item/body accounting and forbidden-placeholder rejection before equality, so paired omissions, unsupported nodes and debug fallback values cannot pass. This claim is only partially implemented; the generic guarantee remains deferred.

Both ordinary run_fixture associations point to the same implementation. Standard fixtures obtain independent oracle and Sage results from run_combined, write their outputs, then run separate checks on each side for three specifically named fixtures before exact comparison. Captured combined entry confirms separate output values; no coverage check repairs either value. Diagnostic-annotated fixtures take a separate annotation-checking path and are not generic emitted-body coverage evidence.

For mini_redis/db_drop_guard.rs, the coverage helper requires the source-written db block/tail, an external core Clone::clone path with exact Mod/Trait/Fn kinds, a shared borrow, resolved field index zero, explicit dereference and self local zero. Each side also independently matches the checked-in exact snapshot. For mini_redis/parse_next.rs, checks require the next body, ok_or direct target and owner/method substitutions, nested Iterator::next static dispatch, concrete IntoIter<Frame,Global> Self and mutable receiver borrow. Its snapshot check rejects unresolved alias/debug/unsupported strings and independently compares each side to the fixed snapshot. For basics/external_adt_default.rs, the helper requires take's parameter type, external IntoIter and its local element plus external Global default. These are useful narrow acceptance checks but not exhaustive per-source item/body inventories. Captured snapshot dependencies are expected observations, not inputs used to rewrite emission. This review evaluates validation logic, not the authored expression checker which produces some native nodes.

Outside those fixture names, run_fixture goes directly to exact equality without a generic independent coverage validator. Captured comparator source accepts equal text and supplies diagnostic differences only after inequality; therefore it cannot detect paired absence by itself. The associated implementation TODO explicitly states this limitation and requires shared coverage validation and independent source inventories. This is an acknowledged gap rather than a newly resolved implementation claim.

Both complete associated tests are TODO-only with no executable assertions. service_spec requests the full independent-removal/replacement matrix over items, associated/generated/source bodies, expressions and types. generic_independent_coverage_requires_source_inventories_and_validator names the concrete prerequisite and requires enabling the paired-unsupported regression, then adding paired item/body omissions and debug fallbacks. The captured ignored paired_unsupported_bodies_cannot_satisfy_conformance creates a source if-expression fixture and expects run_fixture rejection; its ignore reason explicitly records the missing generic validator. It is not eligible ordinary coverage and was not run during this review. No claim is made that its expected rejection currently passes.

Captured oracle-guide explicitly describes this destination and the interim vertical-slice checks, including the stated exclusion of compiler derive bodies while source-written and source-macro methods remain in scope. No broad conformance guarantee is inferred from the current checks or centrally reported suites. No Rust edits or tests executed; commands were fresh review start/read and source inspection before record. No additional requested edits beyond existing explicit deferral; implementing inventories/validator and the adversarial matrix remains necessary to complete the claim.
